Method of Attack: Speculative execution side-channel data-sampling attacks leaking data from CPU buffers
Discoverer: RIDL: VUSec (Vrije University Amsterdam and CISPA); Fallout: University of Michigan, University of Adelaide, Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Data61, Graz IAIK, KU Leuven; ZombieLoad: Not explicitly stated but related to RIDL researchers
Impacted Systems: Intel CPUs released since 2008 including 9th generation processors; servers, laptops, desktop computers; cloud computing resources and virtual machines; systems running Linux (e.g., /etc/shadow, /proc/version) and SGX enclaves
Attack Vector: Running unprivileged malicious code on vulnerable Intel CPUs; malicious JavaScript on webpages or advertisements; shared cloud computing resources or virtual machines
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept code published on GitHub; videos demonstrating data leaks from /etc/shadow, /proc/version, and via JavaScript; security advisories and microcode updates from Intel; CVE identifiers: CVE-2018-12126, CVE-2018-12127, CVE-2018-12130, CVE-2019-11091
